summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Salud Nutrition. Executed 23 pytest backend tests covering auth, public catalog (search/filter/locked detail), subscription flow (register -> pay -> admin approve -> full recipe unlocked), admin recipes CRUD, admin users grant/revoke/delete, settings, and stats. All 23 passed (100%). Executed Playwright UI flows covering: public /recetas search 'quinua' (8->1), category filter 'veganos' (2), locked panel visible for anonymous recipe detail, /register lands on /suscripcion, payment method + proof upload transitions banner to 'Pago en revisión', admin /admin stats, Pagos tab approve button, admin manual recipe creation appearing in public catalog, Users tab create+grant+revoke, Ajustes de Pago save updates public /api/settings. All critical UX flows work.

minor.issue: The update filter uses {'id': p['user_id'], 'subscription_status': 'pending'} — this is a MongoDB filter that only clears status when user's subscription_status is 'pending'. Logically ok but silently no-ops in some states; acceptable.

integration_issues.issue: After successful admin login the app navigates to /recetas (hard-coded in Login.jsx), not /admin. Admin must click 'Admin' in the nav to reach the dashboard. Consider redirecting admins to /admin.

action_items: (Optional UX) In Login.jsx, if the returned user.role === 'admin' navigate('/admin') else navigate('/recetas').
(Optional) reject_payment filter uses user_id in an implicit 'id' key coupled with 'subscription_status' pending — behaviour is correct but a bit brittle; consider making the reset explicit.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~690 lines - approaching the 700 line soft limit; consider splitting auth/admin/recipes routers into modules for maintainability.
Login.jsx always redirects to /recetas regardless of role — admin UX slightly awkward.
reject_payment update filter mixes user_id and subscription_status in the same query dict which is subtle; explicit is better.
get_recipe locked flag: on JWT decode failure the code sets `locked = False if False else True` (odd expression) — functionally equivalent to True but confusing; simplify to `locked = True`.
All endpoints correctly exclude Mongo _id, use env-based config, and return proper HTTP codes.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@saludnutrition.com / Admin2026! (seeded on startup). Test clients are created dynamically via /register with TEST_ / qa_ email prefixes.
seed_data_creation: Test users created dynamically with unique emails; test recipes created with prefix 'TEST_' and deleted in teardown of the corresponding test. A few test clients + one approved payment remain in DB but don't affect further runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 23 backend pytest tests pass and can be re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Playwright UI flows all worked. The one non-blocking UX suggestion is that admin login redirects to /recetas instead of /admin. PDF Gemini extraction endpoint (/api/admin/pdf-extract) was NOT deeply tested per instructions.
